key_concepts: The crust is the Earth's outermost covering.
The mantle is the thickest layer of the Earth.
The inner core is the innermost layer of the Earth.

Seismic waves are vibrations that travel through the Earth.
S-waves move the ground side to side.
Earth's layers have distinct thicknesses and depths.
A scale of 1 cm = 100 km can represent Earth layer thicknesses.
